rows.prerequisites: None: it opens where its name is pressed.
rows.reads: The hour of hoursOn.
rows.changes: Nothing: it shows what the engine holds.
rows.experienced: When opened: says one hour’s sky as the hourly curve has it.
rows.saveLoad: Nothing of its own: it reads the save as it stands.
rows.purpose: Says one hour’s sky as the hourly curve has it.

rows.where: The Week Ahead, from the weather; weather.tsx.
rows.prerequisites: None: it opens where its name is pressed.
rows.reads: forecastFor for six days.
rows.changes: Nothing: it shows what the engine holds.
rows.experienced: When opened: shows the week’s days, each opening onto its sky.
rows.saveLoad: Nothing of its own: it reads the save as it stands.
rows.purpose: Shows the week’s days, each opening onto its sky.

rows.where: Each dial on How You Are and the person look; wellbeing.tsx.
rows.prerequisites: None: it opens where its name is pressed.
rows.reads: The dial’s figure and what it decides (mendsTo, moraleSettlesAt, workoutCosts and the lines the hourly charge reads).
rows.changes: Nothing: it shows what the engine holds.
rows.experienced: When opened: says the dial’s figure and what it does to the body, with the engine’s own figures.
rows.saveLoad: Nothing of its own: it reads the save as it stands.
rows.purpose: Says the dial’s figure and what it does to the body, with the engine’s own figures.

rows.where: An injury or a long-term condition, from the person look and How You Are; wellbeing.tsx.
rows.prerequisites: None: it opens where its name is pressed.
rows.reads: The injury’s kind, mending date and what it keeps them from (injuryKeeps); a long-term condition kept up or let go.
rows.changes: Nothing: it shows what the engine holds.
rows.experienced: When opened: says when an injury mends and what it keeps the player from, as the refusals it causes say; and what a long-term condition does left alone.
rows.saveLoad: Nothing of its own: it reads the save as it stands.
rows.purpose: Says when an injury mends and what it keeps the player from, as the refusals it causes say; and what a long-term condition does left alone.

rows.where: What Needs You and Home’s notices: “Something Didn’t Go Through” or “<label> Didn’t Go Through”, sent from core/simulation.ts as the clock runs.
rows.prerequisites: A scheduled handler that throws, or a command it raises that fails, while the clock moves.
rows.reads: The item’s label and category, the refusal’s words.
rows.changes: A notice; the item marked missed (the advance loop’s own).
rows.experienced: The notice in What Needs You, and the item’s Missed status on its entry.
rows.saveLoad: The notice and the item’s status are in the save.
rows.missing: No handler of the current game is known to fault or refuse as the clock runs, so no life the gate plays reaches it.
rows.why: The gate reaches it only through handlers tests/simulation.test.ts registers for it (“says a fault met as time passes in words, as missed where it was a calendar item, and never claims it undone”), which holds its words true; no current life’s play reaches it.
rows.purpose: Tells the player, in words, that something the clock ran failed or was refused as time passed, and that a calendar item it was shows as missed, without claiming it undone.

rows.where: What Needs You and Home’s notices, the injury’s label as its title, sent by mayHurt (systems/injury.ts) when a workout, a run, a call, a shift or everyday life hurts.
rows.prerequisites: An injury drawn at its source’s rate, while not already hurt.
rows.reads: The injury’s kind and days, the School, the care’s cost through the plan, workers’ compensation’s state rules.
rows.changes: A notice (the injury itself, its bill and its stress and morale are mayHurt’s mechanic).
rows.experienced: The notice the moment it happens; Go There to Papers, where the bill is.
rows.saveLoad: The notice is in the save; a reload sends it no second time (evidence-g04-life: said once).
rows.purpose: Tells the player the injury, the day it mends, what it keeps them from and what its care costs or that work’s compensation pays.

promises.claim: A night is what moves energy, sleep debt and condition most.
promises.holds: applySleep moves energy, sleep debt and condition by the night’s hours and quality (src/engine/systems/life.ts:926, :929, :969); a waking hour moves them by a few points (life.ts:219).

promises.claim: A meal, a shower, a workout and an hour unwinding each move the measures they name, and the menu says by how much.
promises.holds: applyLookingAfter moves each action’s measures (src/engine/systems/life.ts:716); the menu’s figures are applyLookingAfter on a copy (lookAfterOptions, life.ts:797).

promises.claim: Readiness sets how much a class or a lab builds that day.
promises.holds: A class builds each skill by focusAt, read from readiness (src/engine/systems/school.ts:3516, :950).

promises.claim: A night on stage is judged with your readiness at curtain time: under ${EVALUATION.sufficientReadiness}, coming in tired costs you.
promises.holds: A night is judged with conditionAt’s readiness at the call (src/engine/systems/school.ts:967); under EVALUATION.sufficientReadiness the judgment names fatigue and takes it off (src/engine/systems/evaluation.ts:427).
promises.why: No test the gate runs plays a School night through the clock at readiness under 60 and reads its fatigue. The rule is the evaluation’s, held for a taped piece at readiness 30 (tests/integration-mastery.test.ts) and for a shoot day judged tired through the clock (tests/b20-life-fatigue.test.ts), which read the same conditionAt and sufficientReadiness.

promises.claim: Under ${ESTIMATE.sickBelow} condition, calling in sick is excused.
promises.holds: sickRefusal takes a sick day under ESTIMATE.sickBelow condition (src/engine/systems/school.ts:185), and the classes handler excuses the day (school.ts:3497).

promises.claim: Long-term conditions are kept up or let go on Papers, and your own page says which.
promises.holds: health.treat keeps a long-term condition up or lets it go (src/engine/systems/health.ts:2387); the condition look says which (src/ui/looks/wellbeing.tsx, the condition look).

promises.claim: A night moves energy, stress, sleep debt, condition and morale by the time you wake.
promises.holds: applySleep at the wake: energy, stress, sleep debt, condition and morale (src/engine/systems/life.ts:926, :951, :929, :969, :977).

promises.claim: A commitment during the night goes ahead without you, and it counts as missed.
promises.holds: Each handler finds the sleeper absent: a plan (src/engine/world/plans.ts:138), classes (src/engine/systems/school.ts:1573), a work day (src/engine/systems/projobs.ts:1035).

promises.claim: Commitments you slept through are named in a notice the next morning.
promises.holds: life.sleep names what it ran over in a notice as they wake (src/engine/systems/life.ts:439).

promises.claim: Classes and calls you sleep through are absences the faculty weigh at the end of the term.
promises.holds: Classes slept through are missed, unexcused, on the term’s tally (src/engine/systems/school.ts:1573, :3533), which the term review reads against ESTIMATE.attendanceFloor (school.ts:3233).

promises.claim: Skipping ahead through the night sleeps for you, but it’s a poorer night that stops at ${COASTING_ENERGY_CEILING} energy.
promises.holds: A jump of more than an hour through the night pays a night nobody chose at 0.95 of its quality, its energy held to COASTING_ENERGY_CEILING (src/engine/systems/life.ts:1337, :1352).

promises.claim: Each line moves the measures it names, and readiness with them.
promises.holds: lookAfterOptions lists each line’s dials from and to, and the readiness it gives (src/engine/systems/life.ts:797); the command applies the same arithmetic (life.ts:489).

promises.claim: Work Out checks the weather as its hour ends to decide whether it was a run.
promises.holds: Work Out reads trainingAt after its hour is lived, at s.now (src/engine/systems/life.ts:486, :55).

promises.claim: A meal is paid the way How You Pay pays the day’s spending: the debit card, the credit card or cash.
promises.holds: A meal is paid through spend, which pays as How You Pay is set (src/engine/systems/life.ts:480; src/engine/systems/spending.ts:323).

promises.claim: The fitness a workout builds is your Stamina on the Player Profile.
promises.holds: Stamina is fitness (src/engine/systems/attributes.ts:150); a workout records its gain as stamina (src/engine/systems/life.ts:491).

promises.claim: An injury from a run or a workout needs care, and you may owe a share of its cost.
promises.holds: A workout may hurt at its rate (src/engine/systems/life.ts:498); the care is billed at what the plan leaves (src/engine/systems/injury.ts:134).

promises.claim: A commitment only arrives as the clock moves, and Play opens with the chapter after this one.
promises.holds: Items run only as the clock reaches them (src/engine/core/simulation.ts:438); Play opens with The Clock (src/engine/content/tutorial.ts:175).

promises.claim: Every move of the clock, Advance and Choose An Event among them, stops here at each commitment.
promises.holds: Every advance from a screen stops at an item that wants the player (src/engine/core/simulation.ts:441; src/app/game-context.tsx:240, :377).

promises.claim: The plans you put on the calendar yourself are the commitments Skip It works on.
promises.holds: Skip It is a plan’s only (src/engine/world/plans.ts:205; src/engine/world/clock.ts:105).

promises.claim: Classes, calls and shifts you went to or missed are counted at the end of each term’s classes.
promises.holds: The classes, calls and shifts kept or missed go on the term’s tally (src/engine/systems/school.ts:3509, :3533), which the term review reads (school.ts:3233).

promises.claim: Calling in sick before a school day begins excuses the commitments you’d otherwise miss.
promises.holds: A day called in sick is excused at its classes (src/engine/systems/school.ts:3497) and its calls (school.ts:3557).

promises.claim: A rehearsal with a classmate stops the clock like any commitment, and its dialog offers Call It Off, at a cost to their trust.
promises.holds: A partner’s rehearsal wants the player and stops the clock; its stop offers Call It Off (src/engine/world/clock.ts:114), which costs trust at short notice (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:2030).

promises.claim: The live clock stops and pauses at each commitment on the calendar, and asks.
promises.holds: The live clock advances with stopOnPlayerRequired and halts at the stop (src/app/game-context.tsx:377, :215).

promises.claim: Every second the clock runs is charged to your energy, food and the rest of your wellbeing as waking time, as it passes.
promises.holds: Every stretch the clock crosses is charged as waking time (src/engine/systems/life.ts:354, :267).

promises.claim: For hours you don’t want to wait through, Advance jumps them.
promises.holds: The Advance menu jumps the clock (src/ui/shell/TimeControls.tsx, AdvanceMenu; src/app/game-context.tsx:240).

promises.claim: A live clock keeps you up past midnight; Sleep is how the night gets slept.
promises.holds: A move of an hour or less is the player’s, who keeps them up (src/engine/systems/life.ts:1265); Sleep sleeps the night (life.ts:433).

promises.claim: Every jump stops at each commitment on the way, and the stop’s dialog asks whether you go.
promises.holds: Every jump stops at each commitment on the way (src/engine/core/simulation.ts:441), and the stop asks Go or Stand Here (TimeControls.tsx DueNow).

promises.claim: A jump of more than an hour through the night sleeps your character from midnight, a night that stops at ${COASTING_ENERGY_CEILING} energy.
promises.holds: A jump of more than an hour sleeps the night alone from midnight, at most 74 energy (src/engine/systems/life.ts:1265, :1337, :1352).

promises.claim: Each midnight crossed buys the day’s groceries and tops up nourishment and hygiene.
promises.holds: Each midnight crossed buys the day’s groceries and eats up to the day’s nourishment, and washes to 82 (src/engine/systems/life.ts:1087, :1092).

promises.claim: The hours you’d rather live than skip, the live clock runs one to one.
promises.holds: The live clock runs world time one to one (src/engine/core/realclock.ts:37; src/app/game-context.tsx:377).

promises.claim: Your return’s question carries File It, which files the year’s return as Papers would.
promises.holds: The return’s question carries File It, which runs the filing command (src/engine/systems/taxreturn.ts:1354).

promises.claim: When your US status is ending, its question carries Apply For OPT while that can still be applied for.
promises.holds: The status’s ending raises a question with Apply For OPT while it can be applied for (src/engine/systems/permission.ts:342).

promises.claim: Before a long-untouched account goes to the state, the bank’s question carries Keep The Account.
promises.holds: A long-untouched account’s question carries Keep The Account (src/engine/systems/accountlife.ts:748).

promises.claim: A Sleep that ran over commitments leaves a notice naming each one it slept through.
promises.holds: life.sleep’s notice names each commitment slept through (src/engine/systems/life.ts:439).

promises.claim: Go There takes you to the screen a notice or a question is about.
promises.holds: Each notice and question with a route has Go There, which goes to it (src/ui/screens/Home.tsx:300; src/ui/looks/attention.tsx:239).

promises.claim: A plan is a commitment: when the clock reaches it, the clock stops and asks Go or Skip It.
promises.holds: A plan wants the player (src/engine/world/plans.ts:187), so the clock stops at it (src/engine/core/simulation.ts:441) and its stop offers Skip It (src/engine/world/clock.ts:105).

promises.claim: The Sleep dialog lists a plan inside its hours as one you’d sleep through, and sleeping through misses it.
promises.holds: The Sleep dialog lists what its hours cross (src/ui/shell/TimeControls.tsx:326); asleep at it, the plan is missed (src/engine/world/plans.ts:138).

promises.claim: A plan about to begin refuses anything in Look After Yourself that would run into it.
promises.holds: lookAfterRefusal refuses what would run into anything wanting the player (src/engine/systems/life.ts:657).

promises.claim: An hour of practice that would run into a plan is refused until the plan has passed.
promises.holds: practiceRefusal refuses an hour that would run into a commitment (src/engine/systems/practice.ts:62).

promises.claim: Skipping a plan, or sleeping through one, leaves a notice in What Needs You.
promises.holds: Skip It sends “You Didn’t Go To …” (src/engine/world/plans.ts:214); a Sleep over it names it (src/engine/systems/life.ts:439).

promises.claim: A plan’s hours open onto the sky over each of them.
promises.holds: A plan’s entry opens its hours (src/ui/looks/day.tsx:619), each hour its sky (the stretch look, src/ui/looks/plans.tsx).

promises.claim: Work Out checks the weather as it ends: dry and mild, it was a run, building more fitness and burning more.
promises.holds: trainingAt: dry and mild, a run, building TRAINING.run (src/engine/systems/life.ts:55); it burns a run’s MET (life.ts:497).

promises.claim: The weather is the same town’s, beside its time, season and daylight on Home.
promises.holds: Home’s first line is the town’s weather now, beside its time, zone and season (src/ui/screens/Home.tsx:108).

promises.claim: The flu comes in your town’s climate’s weeks for it, and a day with the flu is one to call in sick.
promises.holds: The flu’s week by the town’s climate (src/engine/systems/health.ts:1773); a day with the flu is one to call in sick (src/engine/systems/school.ts:185).
